limits: Accessibility checks inspect Chromium's accessibility tree; native screen-reader speech was not manually verified.
Offline, aborted-response and 500 console failures were deliberately injected to verify recovery; no JavaScript runtime errors occurred.
HTTP/gameplay checks create disposable in-memory games on the public service; they do not verify game persistence across process restarts.
This record verifies runtime commit 7f9a5a3. A subsequent evidence-only commit does not change deployed application files.
